title: General checklist: a calling or messaging feature is not working

Symptoms: A calling or messaging feature (for example call forwarding, conference numbers, international SMS or spam filtering) behaves unexpectedly and no specific article matches.
Resolution steps:
1. Confirm whether the issue affects incoming, outgoing or both directions.
2. Test with a different number or destination to see whether the issue is specific.
3. Restart the device and test again.
4. Record the numbers involved (masked), the times and any message heard, then escalate.
Customer steps:
1. Check whether the problem affects calls or messages you make, ones you receive, or both.
2. Try a different number to see whether the problem only happens with one number.
3. Restart your phone and try again.
4. If it still isn't working, tell me roughly when it happens and any message you hear, and our team will investigate.
Escalate when: The feature still fails after the test calls.
Caution: General guidance only, not a confirmed fix. Never read out or store full customer numbers.
Source note: SYNTHETIC / DEMO DATA - not real telecom operator data.

title: General checklist: SIM, eSIM or connected device problem
content:
Symptoms: A SIM, eSIM, smartwatch, tablet, car or vehicle connectivity module, or other connected device line does not work as expected and no specific article matches.
Resolution steps:
1. Confirm which device and which line or profile are affected.
2. Check that the line or eSIM profile is shown as active for the device.
3. Restart both the device and any paired phone.
4. Record the device model, the profile status and any message shown, then escalate if it remains unresolved.
Customer steps:
1. Check which device and which line or eSIM profile are affected.
2. Make sure the line or eSIM profile shows as active on the device.
3. Restart both the device and any phone it's paired with.
4. If it still isn't working, tell me the device model, the profile status and any message you see.
Escalate when: The line or profile is active but the device still cannot use it.
Caution: General guidance only. eSIM or SIM changes always require the approved identity verification.
Source note: SYNTHETIC / DEMO DATA - not real telecom operator data.

title: General checklist: billing, payment or account enquiry
content:
Symptoms: A billing, payment, balance or account question does not match a specific article.
Resolution steps:
1. Identify the bill, transaction or account item the customer is asking about.
2. Review the item through the approved billing or account view.
3. Explain only what the approved view shows.
4. Route the case to billing or account support if the item cannot be explained.
Customer steps:
1. Tell me which bill, payment or account item you're asking about.
2. We'll review it using your account records.
3. We'll explain exactly what your account shows.
4. If it can't be explained, our billing or account team will look into it.
Escalate when: The item cannot be explained from the approved view.
Caution: General guidance only. Do not quote prices, credits, refunds or timelines.
Source note: SYNTHETIC / DEMO DATA - not real telecom operator data.

title: Moving an eSIM to a new phone (draft - pending review)
content:
Symptoms: The customer bought a new phone and wants to move their eSIM.
Resolution steps:
1. Verify the account through the approved identity process.
2. Issue a new eSIM profile for the new device.
3. Ask the customer to install the profile and restart the phone.
Customer steps:
1. We'll first verify your account.
2. We'll issue a new eSIM profile for your new phone.
3. Install the new profile on your phone, then restart it.
Escalate when: The new profile does not install.
